product_one_liner.value: Envoy provides an enterprise workplace management platform that helps facilities, security, and IT teams manage visitors, spaces, and workplace communications.
product_one_liner.notes: Envoy describes a unified workplace platform for visitors, spaces, and communications, and explicitly names facilities, security, and IT teams as users: https://envoy.com/products.

pricing_page.notes: Envoy has a public pricing page listing plans, including an Enterprise plan with custom pricing: https://envoy.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Envoy's customer stories identify Conductor and describe Iterable's use of the platform: https://www.envoy.com/case-studies and https://envoy.com/case-studies/iterable. | named_customers.0: Conductor is named in Envoy's customer stories: https://www.envoy.com/case-studies. | named_customers.1: The case study explicitly describes Iterable using Envoy: https://envoy.com/case-studies/iterable.

employee_band.notes: The investor's Envoy jobs profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees, matching the requested band: https://jobs.a16z.com/jobs/envoy.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Envoy explicitly labels San Francisco as its headquarters: https://envoy.com/about-us. | hq_country: The company identifies San Francisco as its headquarters, and its company profile places that location in the United States: https://envoy.com/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/envoy-inc.

founded_year.notes: Envoy's company profile explicitly lists 2013 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/envoy-inc.

eng_blog.notes: The official engineering blog presents two substantive build posts by Envoy builders: Shraddha Chadha's August 10, 2026 Kafka/LLM threat-detection pipeline post and Matthew Ellwood's July 16, 2026 React-in-Ember migration post. Their individual job titles are not stated in the excerpts, but the blog identifies its authors as the people building Envoy. Source: https://engineering.envoy.com/.

public_docs.notes: Envoy has a public developer portal with guides and API documentation, plus a help center containing multiple product and compliance articles: https://developers.envoy.com/, https://envoy.help/en/articles/3450292-envoy-compliance-certifications, and https://envoy.help/en/articles/16301838-ai-usage-in-envoy-products.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: All 20 current openings were inspected on the complete job board. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Senior Data Analyst, Marketing is excluded by the question's rule, and generic engineering titles are not reclassified from their descriptions. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/envoy.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude via Amazon Bedrock; Amazon Web Services Rekognition.
model_provider.notes: Envoy's AI FAQ explicitly names Anthropic Claude through Amazon Bedrock and AWS Rekognition for image recognition and facial matching: https://envoy.help/en/articles/16301838-ai-usage-in-envoy-products.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding round is the January 11, 2022 Series C, which predates the 18-month window. The dated announcement is at https://envoy.com/workplace-management/envoy-series-c-cant-stop-wont-stop.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists an EMEA Outbound BDR opening, supported by its live role posting: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/envoy and https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Envoy/50fb0d1e-fa3a-4f05-b40f-df0149882eec.

launched_6mo.notes: Envoy dates the launch of Envoy Response, combining AI-analyzed threat intelligence and incident management, to August 6, 2026, within the six-month window: https://envoy.com/ai-information.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Envoy's official press feed dates its announcement of Mauricio Ramirez's appointment as Chief Revenue Officer to July 28, 2026, within the 12-month window. Sources: https://envoy.com/press-release/rss.xml and https://envoy.com/press-release/envoy-appoints-mauricio-ramirez-as-chief-revenue-officer.
